    What not to mix with alprazolam

    Full profile

    Choose what it would be combined with:

    Combined withWhat happensLabel guidance
    Opioids (oxycodone, fentanyl, codeine)Slowed breathing, coma, deathBoxed warning; avoid unless no alternative
    AlcoholStronger sedation and slowed breathingAvoid
    Other sedatives and sleep medicinesAdditive drowsiness and impaired coordinationUse caution
    Ketoconazole, itraconazoleSharply raise alprazolam levelsDo not combine
    Nefazodone, fluvoxamine, cimetidine, erythromycinRaise alprazolam levelsLower dose or caution
    Carbamazepine, phenytoinLower alprazolam levelsMay reduce effect
